**Depot:** Fenbury
**Context:**
- Lifts near garden studio, north office, print room, library annex, and harbour room are slow.
- Repainting: Garden studio, north office, print room, loading bay (afternoon), harbour room (morning). North office has evening noise. Print room has morning noise.
- Stand-ups: Morning (harbour room), Afternoon (east wing), Evening (harbour room).
- Out: Mira, Opal, Rafe, Wren, Vik, Una, Jonah, Kira. Hugo is out for the rest of the week; Bram covers him.
- Coverage: Pia (Mira/Opal), Dell (Jonah/Nils/Vik), Greta (Wren), Finn (Kira). Vik covers Jonah. Ada covers Rafe.
- Visitor requests: Opal, Hugo, Ines, Vik, Una, Suri, Ada want print room, harbour room, garden studio, library annex clear. Una also wants loading bay clear. Leon wants harbour room clear. Ada wants library annex clear. Greta wants north office clear. Suri wants harbour room kept clear. Ines wants print room kept clear.
- Preferences: Wren (east wing), Kira (print room), Una (north office). Jonah prefers library annex for reviews. Rafe prefers loading bay for reviews. Suri prefers print room for reviews. Esme prefers garden studio for reviews.
- Desk swaps: Greta/Mira, Opal/Hugo, Opal/Suri, Cora/Nils, Leon/Rafe, Ines/Bram, Greta/Ines, Ines/Jonah.
- Umbrellas: Garden studio, north office, library annex, print room, harbour room, loading bay, east wing.
- Cold spots: Wren (loading bay morning), Esme (loading bay evening), Ada (north office evening), Leon (east wing afternoon), Bram (north office morning, harbour room afternoon). Pia thinks print room is too cold in the morning. Finn thinks garden studio is too cold in the evening. Finn thinks east wing is too cold in the afternoon.
- Coffee machines: Garden studio, harbour room, east wing, north office, library annex, print room working.
- Notes to send: Mira, Jonah, Pia, Kira, Bram (evening meeting notes). Still need to send Jonah morning and afternoon meeting notes. Finn needs afternoon meeting notes.
- Queries: Greta (harbour room evening), Cora (library annex afternoon), Mira (garden studio evening), Dell (print room afternoon availability). Finn asked if loading bay is free in the morning. Teo asked if east wing is free in the afternoon. Una asked if print room is free in the afternoon.
- Action items: Check with Pia, Esme, Jonah, Vik. Check with Nils before morning meeting. Check with Greta before morning meeting. Check with Leon before afternoon meeting. Check with Bram before evening meeting.
